caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a flared, slightly pinched spout. The jug also features a single curved handle that extends from the upper neck to the midsection. The surface of the jug is a light grayish-brown color and has a smooth texture. Near the top of the jug, just below the neck, the year "1862" is inscribed. Below the inscription and slightly to the right, there is a decorative engraving resembling an ear of corn with leaves. The jug is set against a plain, light background with no additional objects. The artist's signature, "Richard Barnett," appears twice in the lower right corner of the image, once in darker ink and once in lighter ink near the jug.
title: Stoneware Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
